# Muse Hardware Library

> A bilingual (English/中文) library of real community hardware projects built with Meta Muse: ESP32, M5Stack, Raspberry Pi, e-ink displays, smart home integrations and robots. Every build links to its public source. Use this file to navigate the site's content.

## Browse

- [Home (English)](https://muse-hardware-lib.vercel.app/en): Latest builds feed, newest first, with sponsored slots clearly labeled.
- [首页（中文）](https://muse-hardware-lib.vercel.app/zh): 最新案例信息流，时间倒序。

## Categories

- [Smart Home / 智能家居](https://muse-hardware-lib.vercel.app/en/categories/smart-home): Muse connected to Home Assistant and real devices.
- [Robots / 机器人](https://muse-hardware-lib.vercel.app/en/categories/robots): Desktop companions with servos and personality, including StackChan builds.
- [Wearables / 可穿戴](https://muse-hardware-lib.vercel.app/en/categories/wearable): E-ink companions, DIY charms and pocket builds.
- [Dev Boards in Action / 开发板实战](https://muse-hardware-lib.vercel.app/en/categories/dev-boards): ESP32-S3, M5Stack, Raspberry Pi — flashing firmware and porting the gadget SDK.
- [Sensors / 传感器](https://muse-hardware-lib.vercel.app/en/categories/sensors): Giving Muse senses — temperature, motion, air quality.
- [Displays & E-Ink / 显示与墨水屏](https://muse-hardware-lib.vercel.app/en/categories/displays): E-ink status screens, AMOLED faces, morning-briefing displays.

## Build sources by type

- [GitHub open source](https://muse-hardware-lib.vercel.app/en/type/github): Code-first builds you can clone and flash.
- [Video](https://muse-hardware-lib.vercel.app/en/type/video): Demos, teardowns and build logs.
- [Articles](https://muse-hardware-lib.vercel.app/en/type/article): Tutorials, reviews and deep dives.
- [Social](https://muse-hardware-lib.vercel.app/en/type/social): Short demos from makers on social platforms.

## Contribute and advertise

- [Submit a build](https://muse-hardware-lib.vercel.app/en/submit): Suggest a community build. Receipts required: every submission must link a public source; claims are described, not endorsed.
- [Advertise](https://muse-hardware-lib.vercel.app/en/advertise): Native feed placements, category banners and newsletter sponsorships.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://muse-hardware-lib.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable list of all pages.
